verses.original: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הַטֵּֽה־ יְהוָ֣ה אָזְנְךָ֣ עֲנֵ֑נִי כִּֽי־ עָנִ֖י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: tə·p̄il·lāh lə·ḏā·wiḏ haṭ·ṭêh- Yah·weh ’ā·zə·nə·ḵā ‘ă·nê·nî kî- ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn ’ā·nî
verses.literal: A prayer of David Incline Your ear O LORD and answer me for I am poor and needy
verses.literalPt: Inclina, Jeová, os teus ouvidos e responde-me, porque eu sou aflito e necessitado.

verses.original: שָֽׁמְרָ֣ה נַפְשִׁי֮ כִּֽי־ חָסִ֪יד אָ֥נִי הוֹשַׁ֣ע עַ֭בְדְּךָ אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֑י הַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·mə·rāh nap̄·šî kî- ḥā·sîḏ ’ā·nî hō·wō·ša‘ ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ’at·tāh ’ĕ·lō·hay hab·bō·w·ṭê·aḥ ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Preserve my soul for I am godly You are my God save Your servant who trusts in You
verses.literalPt: Preserva a minha alma, pois sou piedoso; tu, Deus meu, salva ao teu servo que em ti confia.

verses.original: חָנֵּ֥נִי אֲדֹנָ֑י כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֶ֝קְרָ֗א כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.literal: Be merciful to me O Lord for I call to You all day long
verses.literalPt: Compadece-te de mim, Senhor, pois a ti clamo de contínuo.

verses.original: שַׂ֭מֵּחַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃
verses.literal: Bring joy to Your servant for to You O Lord I lift up my soul
verses.literalPt: Alegra a alma do teu servo, porque a ti, Senhor, elevo a minha alma.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי ט֣וֹב וְסַלָּ֑ח וְרַב־ חֶ֝֗סֶד לְכָל־ קֹרְאֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ṭō·wḇ wə·sal·lāḥ wə·raḇ- ḥe·seḏ lə·ḵāl qō·rə·’e·ḵā
verses.literal: For You O Lord are kind and forgiving rich in loving devotion to all who call on You
verses.literalPt: Porquanto tu, Senhor, és bom, e pronto em perdoar, e abundante em benignidade para com todos os que te invocam.

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה יְ֭הוָה תְּפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבָה בְּק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ă·zî·nāh Yah·weh tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî wə·haq·šî·ḇāh bə·qō·wl ta·ḥă·nū·nō·w·ṯāy
verses.literal: Hear my prayer O LORD and attend to my plea for mercy
verses.literalPt: Escuta, Jeová, a minha oração, atende à voz das minhas súplicas.

verses.literal: In the day of my distress I call on You because You answer me
verses.literalPt: No dia da minha angústia, a ti clamarei, porque me responderás.

verses.original: אֵין־ כָּמ֖וֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִ֥ים׀ אֲדֹנָ֗י וְאֵ֣ין כְּֽמַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ׃
verses.literal: O Lord there is none like You among the gods nor any works like Yours
verses.literalPt: Não há entre os deuses quem seja semelhante a ti, Senhor; nem há obras como as tuas.

verses.original: כָּל־ גּוֹיִ֤ם׀ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ יָב֤וֹאוּ׀ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אֲדֹנָ֑י וִֽיכַבְּד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- gō·w·yim ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯā yā·ḇō·w·’ū wə·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ’ă·ḏō·nāy wî·ḵab·bə·ḏū liš·me·ḵā
verses.literal: All the nations You have made will come and bow before You O Lord and they will glorify Your name
verses.literalPt: Todas as nações que fizeste virão diante de ti, Senhor, se prostrarão e glorificarão o teu nome.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ גָד֣וֹל אַ֭תָּה וְעֹשֵׂ֣ה נִפְלָא֑וֹת אַתָּ֖ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.literal: For You are great and perform wonders You alone are God
verses.literalPt: Pois tu és grande e fazes maravilhas; só tu és Deus.

verses.original: ה֘וֹרֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה׀ דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ אֲהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ יַחֵ֥ד לְ֝בָבִ֗י לְיִרְאָ֥ה שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·rê·nî Yah·weh dar·ke·ḵā ’ă·hal·lêḵ ba·’ă·mit·te·ḵā ya·ḥêḏ lə·ḇā·ḇî lə·yir·’āh šə·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Teach me Your way O LORD that I may walk in Your truth Give me an undivided heart that I may fear Your name
verses.literalPt: Ensina-me, Jeová, o teu caminho; andarei na tua verdade. Dispõe o meu coração para só temer o teu nome.

verses.original: אוֹדְךָ֤׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּכָל־ לְבָבִ֑י וַאֲכַבְּדָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.literal: I will praise You O Lord my God with all my heart I will glorify Your name forever
verses.literalPt: Dar-te-ei graças, Senhor, Deus meu, de todo o meu coração e glorificarei o teu nome para sempre.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חַ֭סְדְּךָ גָּד֣וֹל עָלָ֑י וְהִצַּ֥לְתָּ נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מִשְּׁא֥וֹל תַּחְתִּיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥas·də·ḵā gā·ḏō·wl ‘ā·lāy wə·hiṣ·ṣal·tā nap̄·šî miš·šə·’ō·wl taḥ·tî·yāh
verses.literal: For great is Your loving devotion to me You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol
verses.literalPt: Pois grande é a tua benignidade para comigo, e livraste a minha alma do mais profundo Sheol.

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ זֵ֘דִ֤ים קָֽמוּ־ עָלַ֗י וַעֲדַ֣ת עָ֭רִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א שָׂמ֣וּךָ לְנֶגְדָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm zê·ḏîm qā·mū- ‘ā·lay wa·‘ă·ḏaṯ ‘ā·rî·ṣîm biq·šū nap̄·šî wə·lō śā·mū·ḵā lə·neḡ·dām
verses.literal: The arrogant rise against me O God a band of ruthless men seeks my life they have no regard for You
verses.literalPt: Ó Deus, os soberbos têm-se levantado contra mim, o ajuntamento de homens violentos tem procurado tirar-me a vida; e não te tem posto diante dos seus olhos.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי אֵל־ רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וְרַב־ חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’êl- ra·ḥūm wə·ḥan·nūn ’e·reḵ ’ap·pa·yim wə·raḇ- ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ
verses.literal: But You O Lord are a compassionate and gracious God slow to anger abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness
verses.literalPt: Mas tu, Senhor, és um Deus compassivo e benigno, tardio em irar-te e abundante em graça e verdade.

verses.original: פְּנֵ֥ה אֵלַ֗י וְחָ֫נֵּ֥נִי תְּנָֽה־ עֻזְּךָ֥ לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעָה לְבֶן־ אֲמָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: pə·nêh ’ê·lay wə·ḥān·nê·nî tə·nāh- ‘uz·zə·ḵā lə·‘aḇ·de·ḵā wə·hō·wō·šî·‘āh lə·ḇen- ’ă·mā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Turn to me and have mercy grant Your strength to Your servant save the son of Your maidservant
verses.literalPt: Volta-te para mim e compadece-te de mim; dá ao teu servo a tua força e salva o filho da tua serva.

verses.original: עֲשֵֽׂה־ עִמִּ֥י א֗וֹת לְט֫וֹבָ֥ה וְיִרְא֣וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י וְיֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עֲזַרְתַּ֥נִי וְנִחַמְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·śêh- ‘im·mî ’ō·wṯ lə·ṭō·w·ḇāh wə·yir·’ū śō·nə·’ay wə·yê·ḇō·šū kî- ’at·tāh Yah·weh ‘ă·zar·ta·nî wə·ni·ḥam·tā·nî
verses.literal: Show me a sign of Your goodness that my enemies may see and be ashamed for You O LORD have helped me and comforted me
verses.literalPt: Dá-me algum sinal do teu favor, para que o vejam e sejam envergonhados os que me odeiam, porque tu, Jeová, me tens ajudado e consolado.
